"''Roger roger.|Darts D'Nar orders an [[AAT Driver Battle Droid]]|}} The '''conquest of Kiros''' was an invasion launched during the [[Clone Wars]]{{TCW|Slaves of the Republic}} in [[20 BBY]] by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Marching into the pacifist [[Artisan colony]] of [[Togruta]]s on the [[planet]] [[Kiros]], the Confederacy's [[B1-series battle droid]] rounded up all members of the population on the order of [[Zygerrian]] [[Darts D'Nar]]. The Togrutas were then taken to Zygerrian empire by Zygerrian [[enslaver]]s. The conquest came as part of the Separatists' alliance with the rebuilding [[Zygerrian Slave Empire]], which the [[Sith Lord]] [[Darth Sidious]] hoped to restore in preparation for his coming [[Galactic Empire]].{{TCW|Escape from Kadavo}} Aware of the Separatist incursion, the [[212th Attack Battalion]] and [[501st Legion]] of the [[Republic Military]] were then dispatched to [[Battle on Kiros|investigate]] the lack of communications from Kiros. {{Battle-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== The conquest of Kiros first appeared within "[[Kidnapped]]" and was identified through Darts D'Nar's entry on the [[Encyclopedia (StarWars.com)|StarWars.com Encyclopedia]]. However, both it{{SWE|characters|dartsdnar|Darts D'Nar}} and its later transfer to the [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]] misspell Kiros as "Kiro." ==Appearances== *{{TCW|Kidnapped}} {{1st}} *{{TCW|Slaves of the Republic}} {{Flash}} *{{TCW|Escape from Kadavo}} {{Flash}} ==Sources== {{IncompleteList}} *{{SWE|characters|dartsdnar|Darts D'Nar}} {{1st}} *{{SWE|technology|zygerrianslaveship|Zygerrian slave ship}} *{{BustCollectionCite|60|Character}} *{{Databank|clone-commander-cody|Clone Commander Cody}} *{{Databank|darts-dnar|Darts D'Nar}} *{{Databank|governor-roshti|Governor Roshti}} *{{Databank|kiros|Kiros}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Conquista de Kiros }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Kiros, conquest of}} [[Category:Battles of Kiros]] [[Category:Battles of the Republic Era]] [[Category:Conquests and occupations]] [[Category:Events during the Clone Wars]] [[Category:Togruta culture]] [[Category:Zygerrian culture]]
